main_text.p: יקר Pretiosus fuit, Pretiosus visus vel habitus est, Pretiosè æstimatus fuit, In pretio fuit. Præ-ter. יְקָרָה בְּעֵינַי Pretiosus visus es in oculis meis, Jesa.43.4. Futur. וִיקַר דָּמָם Et pretiosus est sanguis eorum, Psal.72. v.14. וַיִּקַר Et in pretio erat, 1.Sam.18.30. Hiph. Imper. הַקֵּר רַגְלְךָ Pretiosum habe vel facito pedem tuum, Pro-verb.25.v.17. Futut. אוֹקִיר אָנוֹשׁ Faciam ut pretiosus sit homo, Jesa.13.12.

יָקָר m. Pretiosus, Honorabilis, Rarus, Carus: כָּל־הוֹן Omnem substantiam pretiosam, Prov.1.13. Constr. וְקַר רוּחַ Pretiosus spiritu, Proverb.17.27. scribitur cum ו, sed legitur per י. Plural. בְּנֵי צִיּוֹן הַיְּקָרִים Filii Tzionis pretiosissimi, Thren.4.2. Fœminin. יְקָרָה הִיא Pretiosa est, Proverb.13.5. Et forma constructa pro absoluta, יְקָרָת Pretiosum, Jes.28.16. cui simile vide in עַל : Plur. אַבְנִים יְקָרוֹת Lapides pretiosi, 1.Reg.5.v.17. Aff. בִּיקָרוֹתֶיךָ Inter pretiosas vel caras tuas, Psal.45.10. cum Dagesch euphonico, pro בְּיְקָרוֹתֶיךָ cui simile vide in יתר in Nomine יִתְרוֹן .

יָקַר m. Pretium, Pretiosum, Res pretiosa: Metaphoricè Gloria, Honor: יִתְּנוּ יָקָר Tribuent honorem maritis suis, Esth.1.20. Constr. כִּיקַר כָּרִים Ut pretiosum agnorum, Psal.37.20. Plural. foemin. אוֹר יְקָרוֹת Lux pretiosita-tum, id est, pretiosissima, Zach.14.6. Chald. יְקַר שַׂגִּיא Et gloriam multam, Dan.2.6. וּלִיקַר מַלְכוּתִי Et ad gloriam regni mei, Dan.4.33. Emph. וִיקְרָא Et gloriam, Dan.2.37. & וִיקְרָה Dan.5.20.
יָקִיר m. Pretiosus, Honorabilis, Gloriosus, Carus: הַבֵּן יָקִיר Num filius pretiosus, Jerem.31. v.20. Chald. וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּא Magnus & gloriosus, Esr.4.10.
יקש Vel יָקֹשׁ Laqueum tetendit: Præter. יָקַשְׁתִּי לְךָ Laqueum tetendi tibi, Jer.50.24. Niph. Præter: נוקשת

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied as well as the scan allows. Several vowel points and some Hebrew words in the Futur, Constr. and Emph. lines are doubtful, but no [?] was placed on them. The Hebrew lines in the upper part are small and faint, so their vowel points may be misread. The faint watermark at the lower right is the digitiser's and is left out.
